description: Paired descriptive analysis of completed local cell-cover experiments; no candidate selection.

interpretation.gain_sign: Positive savings mean reference minus candidate.
interpretation.pooled_per_source: Sum of whole-task times divided by sum of source counts; not the mean of case averages.
interpretation.independence: Error fields on one (seed, population) source layout are paired repetitions. Layout comparisons average fields first; no independent-sample uncertainty claim is made.
interpretation.incremental: Adjacent-variant differences are empirical marginal effects in this fixed order; interactions prevent treating them as universal independent benefits.
interpretation.movement: Movement is attributed to the following actual action reason; scan movement can include travel departing a cleared source.
interpretation.stations: Distinct positions and contiguous scan batches are observed; they are not a proof that a fixed station was eliminated.
interpretation.opportunity: Predicted station removals describe the all-negative design scenario, not proven actual or counterfactual savings.
interpretation.optical: Planned optical points include unused suffixes after success; actual optical actions are counted separately.
interpretation.audit: Stored independent audit flags are checked, not recomputed; event counts and time accounting are rechecked without importing a solver.
